notes: Closing rank = us round mein us seat par allot hui aakhri rank. Chhota number = mushkil seat.
Har row ka seat raasta likha hai: aapki category, gender, PwD aur home state par khulne wala sabse aasaan raasta.
JoSAA rounds (R1–R5) seat ke apne rank type par band hote hain; CSAB 1 aur CSAB 2 hamesha CRL par.
JAC Delhi (DTU, NSUT, IIIT-Delhi, IGDTUW): sirf R1–R4. Upgrade aur Spot round ki rank JAC ne publish nahi ki.
≈ Marks = final closing tak pahunchne ke liye lagbhag kitne marks (aapka chuna hua paper type).
2026 ke data par estimate. Asli cutoff har saal badalta hai.
CSAB 1 / CSAB 2 sirf bachi hui seats ke round hain: jo seat sirf wahan se milti hai wo hamesha Borderline hai, isliye uska box peela.
Eligible = Safe + Likely + Borderline, College predictor wala hi rule. Borderline kinare par hai, pakka nahi.
